mentions.name: FURS
mentions.description: FURS is a beta tool that provides Forth with the equivalent of C header files for Cortex-M MCUs, supplying embedded configuration information for up to 100 inbuilt peripherals. It intercepts Forth user source as it is uploaded to the on-chip compiler and transforms it into language the MCU inherently understands, without altering the original source. The entire project (flowcharts, pictures, code, user docs, trouble tickets, wiki) lives in a single Fossil DCVS file under 5MB that includes a built-in web server, viewable from a browser.
mentions.problem: Without this peripheral configuration data, neither C nor Forth (or any other language) has any clue about how to use the MCU's inbuilt peripherals.
mentions.audience: Forth programmers working with Cortex-M microcontrollers
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've just released my beta of FURS.

FURS does for Forth, what headers do for C, namely provide all the embedded configuration information inside a Cortex-M MCU, for the up to 100 inbuilt peripherals.
